summary: Kitchen island holds heavy hot cookware placed near edge over cloths that could slip.

hazards.title: Pot near counter edge on cloth
hazards.detail: Heavy Dutch oven resting on loose towel near edge risks sliding or being pulled off.
fixSteps: Move heavy cookware inward away from island edge.
Use non-slip silicone trivets instead of loose cloth towels.

hazards.title: Loose lid near counter edge
hazards.detail: Heavy enameled cast-iron lid sits near edge and could fall, causing foot injury.
fixSteps: Place lid securely back onto pot or center on island.
Store unused cookware components safely inside cabinets.

products.name: Silicone Heat Resistant Trivet Mats
products.reason: Prevents hot cookware from slipping on smooth quartz surfaces.
products.searchQuery: silicone non-slip trivet mats heat resistant
